statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Sentinel 'FL11-155' of firmness of 237 g/mm at harvest and 226 g/mm after 21 days, berry weight averaging 2.2 g, diameter averaging 17.2 mm, soluble solids averaging 11.1 degrees Brix and an average Brix to acid ratio of 30.67. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
